architecture.source_chain: Tempita templates -> generated pyx/pxd -> Cython-generated C++ -> compiled extension

findings.title: Annoy Cython Meson generator is missing
findings.evidence: scikitplot/annoy/_annoy/meson.build requires ../../_build_utils/tempita.py, but scikitplot/_build_utils/tempita.py is absent in the supplied snapshot.
findings.effect: A clean Cython build cannot establish generation reproducibility.

findings.title: Inactive checked-in annoymodule.cpp can be mistaken for generated authority
findings.evidence: scikitplot/annoy/_annoy/annoymodule.cpp is a fastannoy/pybind11 source and is not referenced by the current Annoy Meson target.
findings.effect: Maintainers can edit or review the wrong C++ file; it is not the Cython-generated translation unit.

findings.title: Cython declaration/header path parity is not ABI parity
findings.evidence: annoylib.pxd.in mirrors C++ classes/templates/signatures from cexternals/_annoy headers.
findings.effect: Static maintenance checks can prove ownership/path wiring, but only a clean Cython/C++ compile and focused runtime tests can validate declarations.

findings.title: Two separately compiled Annoy types coexist
findings.evidence: Public scikitplot.annoy.Index inherits cexternals._annoy.Annoy, while scikitplot.annoy._annoy.Index is a separate Cython extension type.
findings.effect: Tests and maintenance must name which backend/type is under review.

findings.title: Cython template standalone instructions still advertise C++14
findings.evidence: scikitplot/annoy/_annoy/annoylib.pxd.in contains -std=c++14 distutils/manual compile comments, while root meson.build sets cpp_std=c++17 and cexternals/_annoy/src/annoylib.h rejects pre-C++17 builds.
findings.effect: The active Meson build is C++17, but maintainers following the template-local standalone instructions hit a deterministic compile failure.

next_exact_action: Restore or replace the declared Tempita generation program in runtime/build scope, then perform a clean generation + Cython/C++ build before promoting runtime or release status.
